about.text: A mild, crumbly fresh cheese of the North Caucasus made from heated cow milk curdled with sour whey and moulded in baskets; it does not melt when baked or fried.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
Mild, eaten fresh, also dried or smoked; Adyghe version is cow only; coagulation not stated in source

facts.v: Adyghe proper only cow; Circassian cheese elsewhere also sheep or goat
Curd shaped in a wooden basket; dried in the sun or an oven, or smoked
Also made in the Levant and in diaspora communities, such as Kfar Kama and Rehaniya in Israel
